jobs.title: Sidewalk replacement & ADA curb ramps, Denver Federal Center
jobs.description: Remove and replace approximately 14,000 sf of deteriorated sidewalk and construct 62 ADA-compliant curb ramps across the Denver Federal Center campus. Includes demolition, subgrade prep, forming and pouring 4 in. and 6 in. flatwork, detectable warning surfaces, and site restoration. Davis-Bacon wage rates apply. Site visit scheduled — see the solicitation for date and badging requirements.

jobs.title: Concrete trail & drainage pan repairs, Rocky Mountain NP
jobs.description: Repair spalled and heaved concrete trail sections, replace drainage pans, and reset curbing at high-traffic trailheads. Work windows are constrained by visitor season and weather; phasing plan required with bid. Magnitude between $100,000 and $250,000.

jobs.title: Bridge deck overlay & joint repair, I-70 at Ward Road
jobs.description: Hydrodemolition and Class DR concrete overlay of two bridge decks, expansion joint replacement, and approach slab repair on I-70 at Ward Road. Night and weekend lane closures; CDOT prequalification required at bid. Engineer's estimate $2.4M.

jobs.title: Plaza concrete replacement, Auraria Higher Education Center
jobs.buyer: State of Colorado — Auraria Higher Education Center
jobs.description: Phased removal and replacement of approximately 31,000 sf of campus plaza paving, including sand-finish architectural concrete, integral ramps and stairs, snowmelt sleeving coordination, and tree-well adjustments. Summer-break phasing mandatory; liquidated damages for fall-semester overrun.

jobs.title: 2026 sidewalk gap & ADA ramp program
jobs.description: Annual program contract: construct missing sidewalk segments and upgrade non-compliant ramps at approximately 40 locations citywide. Unit-price bid; quantities are estimates and work is released by task order through November 2026. City of Golden or Jefferson County contractor license required before notice to proceed.

jobs.title: Alley paving package 3 — concrete pans & aprons
jobs.buyer: City and County of Denver — DOTI
jobs.description: Reconstruct 18 alleys: 8 in. concrete drainage pans, garage aprons, and connections to existing gutter. Includes demolition, grading, and traffic control in residential alleys. M/WBE participation goal applies — see solicitation for the current percentage and compliance forms.

jobs.title: Culvert headwalls & box extensions, W. 64th Ave
jobs.description: Cast-in-place headwalls and wingwalls at four culvert crossings plus one box culvert extension on W. 64th Ave. Dewatering and temporary stream diversion by contractor; work restricted to the low-flow window. Bids due soon — plan holders list is public on the county procurement page.

jobs.title: Station platform spall repair, Southeast Corridor
jobs.description: Partial-depth spall repair, joint resealing, and tactile edge replacement at six light-rail platforms. All work during non-revenue hours (1 a.m.–4 a.m.); RTD safety certification required for crews before mobilization.

jobs.title: Foundation package, 8-unit townhome — sub bids
jobs.description: GC seeking concrete sub bids for the full foundation package on an 8-unit townhome project: drilled piers, grade beams, stem walls, garage slabs, and porches. Plans and geotech available on request. Looking for crews that can hold a mid-August pour schedule; permit history in Jefferson County is a plus.

jobs.title: Warehouse slab replacement, 22,000 sf
jobs.description: Owner-direct bid: demo and replace 22,000 sf of 6 in. warehouse slab with new vapor barrier, dowelled joints, and FF35/FL25 finish tolerance. Building stays partially occupied — phased pours required. Walk-through available weekday mornings.

jobs.title: Floodwall panel repair & joint replacement, Buffalo Bayou
jobs.buyer: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers — Galveston District
jobs.description: Repair spalled floodwall panels, replace waterstop joints, and re-anchor panel sections along Buffalo Bayou. Work below grade in a dewatered excavation; cofferdam and dewatering plan required with bid. Davis-Bacon wage rates apply.

jobs.title: Bridge rail & deck repairs, I-45 North corridor
jobs.buyer: Texas Department of Transportation — Houston District
jobs.description: Replace substandard bridge rail, partial-depth deck repairs, and approach slab work at five structures on the I-45 North corridor. Night closures only; TxDOT prequalification required. Engineer's estimate $3.1M.

jobs.title: ADA ramp & sidewalk package, Phoenix maintenance district
jobs.description: Construct and retrofit ADA-compliant curb ramps and connecting sidewalk at approximately 90 locations across the Phoenix maintenance district. Unit-price contract; AZ ROC license required at bid.

jobs.title: Concrete bus pads & shelters package 2
jobs.description: Construct 9 in. reinforced concrete bus pads, shelter foundations, and connecting sidewalk at 22 transit stops. Summer heat plan required — night pours permitted; city traffic control standards apply.

jobs.title: FY27 sidewalk & curb program, multiple corridors
jobs.description: Annual program contract for new sidewalk, curb and gutter, and ADA ramps across council-district corridors. Task-order releases through June 2027; DBE participation goal applies. TN contractor license required at bid.

jobs.title: Bus pad & curb replacement package, CATS routes
jobs.description: Replace deteriorated bus pads and curb-and-gutter along CATS routes; 14 locations. Includes pedestrian access maintenance during work and coordination with transit operations for stop closures.

jobs.title: Riverwalk section repairs — slabs, rail bases & joint seals
jobs.description: Repair settled and spalled Riverwalk slab sections, rebuild rail post bases, and reseal expansion joints over water. Marine access required for two segments; work windows coordinated around events calendar.

jobs.title: Tilt-wall & slab package, distribution center — sub bids
jobs.description: GC seeking concrete sub bids for a 240,000 sf distribution center: tilt-wall panels, foundations, and 7 in. interior slab with laser-screed tolerance. Panel engineering by sub; crane coordination with GC. Strong preference for crews with verifiable big-box permit history.

jobs.title: Private streets & valley gutters replacement, 84-lot HOA
jobs.description: Owner-direct bid: replace failed valley gutters, curb sections, and driveway aprons throughout a private 84-lot community. Phased to keep resident access; evening walk-through available. AZ ROC license required.
